local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local world = workspace:FindFirstChild("GrowIslandWorld")
if world then world:Destroy() end
world = Instance.new("Folder")
world.Name = "GrowIslandWorld"
world.Parent = workspace

local event=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GrowIslandFeedback")
if not event then event=Instance.new("RemoteEvent");event.Name="GrowIslandFeedback";event.Parent=ReplicatedStorage end

local function makePart(name,size,pos,color,material,parent)
 local p=Instance.new("Part");p.Name=name;p.Size=size;p.Position=pos;p.Anchored=true;p.Color=color;p.Material=material;p.Parent=parent or world;return p
end
local base=workspace:FindFirstChild("Baseplate");if base then base:Destroy() end
makePart("StarterIsland",Vector3.new(54,4,54),Vector3.new(0,18,0),Color3.fromRGB(82,142,70),Enum.Material.Grass)
makePart("IslandEarth",Vector3.new(50,7,50),Vector3.new(0,12.5,0),Color3.fromRGB(95,68,48),Enum.Material.Ground)
local spawn=Instance.new("SpawnLocation");spawn.Name="IslandSpawn";spawn.Size=Vector3.new(7,1,7);spawn.Position=Vector3.new(0,21,15);spawn.Anchored=true;spawn.Neutral=true;spawn.Transparency=.35;spawn.Parent=world
local core=makePart("EnergyCore",Vector3.new(7,7,7),Vector3.new(0,24,0),Color3.fromRGB(90,180,255),Enum.Material.Neon);core.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
local light=Instance.new("PointLight");light.Brightness=2;light.Range=22;light.Parent=core
local prompt=Instance.new("ProximityPrompt");prompt.Name="GrowPrompt";prompt.ActionText="Grow Island - 10 Energy";prompt.ObjectText="Energy Core";prompt.KeyboardKeyCode=Enum.KeyCode.E;prompt.HoldDuration=.25;prompt.MaxActivationDistance=14;prompt.RequiresLineOfSight=false;prompt.Parent=core

local stages={}
local function hidden(name,size,pos,color,material)
 local p=makePart(name,size,pos,color,material);p.Transparency=1;p.CanCollide=false;table.insert(stages,p)
end
hidden("Expansion1",Vector3.new(34,3,28),Vector3.new(38,18.5,0),Color3.fromRGB(82,142,70),Enum.Material.Grass)
hidden("Expansion2",Vector3.new(30,3,30),Vector3.new(-38,18.5,-8),Color3.fromRGB(75,132,65),Enum.Material.Grass)
hidden("Bridge",Vector3.new(45,2,9),Vector3.new(0,18,49),Color3.fromRGB(118,86,56),Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)
hidden("TreasureIsland",Vector3.new(34,4,34),Vector3.new(0,18,78),Color3.fromRGB(72,126,62),Enum.Material.Grass)
local costs={10,30,70,140}
local function showStage(n) local p=stages[n];if p then p.Transparency=0;p.CanCollide=true end end

local function spawnOrb()
 if not world.Parent then return end
 local orb=Instance.new("Part");orb.Name="EnergyOrb";orb.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball;orb.Size=Vector3.new(2.2,2.2,2.2);orb.Material=Enum.Material.Neon;orb.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,220,80);orb.Anchored=true;orb.CanCollide=false;orb.Position=Vector3.new(math.random(-22,22),22,math.random(-22,22));orb.Parent=world
 local glow=Instance.new("PointLight");glow.Brightness=1;glow.Range=8;glow.Parent=orb
 local taken=false
 orb.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
  if taken then return end
  local player=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent);if not player then return end
  local energy=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Energy");if not energy then return end
  taken=true;energy.Value+=1;orb:Destroy()
 end)
 task.delay(25,function() if orb.Parent then orb:Destroy() end end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
 local stats=Instance.new("Folder");stats.Name="leaderstats";stats.Parent=player
 local energy=Instance.new("IntValue");energy.Name="Energy";energy.Value=0;energy.Parent=stats
 local stage=Instance.new("IntValue");stage.Name="IslandStage";stage.Value=0;stage.Parent=player
end)

local busy={}
prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
 if busy[player] then return end;busy[player]=true
 local energy=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Energy")
 local stage=player:FindFirstChild("IslandStage")
 if energy and stage and stage.Value<#costs then
  local cost=costs[stage.Value+1]
  if energy.Value>=cost then
   energy.Value-=cost;stage.Value+=1;showStage(stage.Value);event:FireClient(player,"Upgrade")
  else
   event:FireClient(player,"NotEnough")
  end
  if stage.Value<#costs then prompt.ActionText="Grow Island - "..costs[stage.Value+1].." Energy" else prompt.ActionText="Island Complete!" end
 end
 task.wait(.3);busy[player]=nil
end)

task.spawn(function()
 while world.Parent do
  local count=0;for _,v in ipairs(world:GetChildren()) do if v.Name=="EnergyOrb" then count+=1 end end
  if count<18 then spawnOrb() end
  task.wait(1.1)
 end
end)
print("Grow the Island - saving disabled")

local ReplicatedStorage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SoundService=game:GetService("SoundService")
local event=ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GrowIslandFeedback")

local success=Instance.new("Sound")
success.Name="IslandUpgradeSound"
success.SoundId="rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav"
success.Volume=.85
success.PlaybackSpeed=.55
success.Parent=SoundService

local successSparkle=Instance.new("Sound")
successSparkle.Name="IslandUpgradeSparkle"
successSparkle.SoundId="rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav"
successSparkle.Volume=.7
successSparkle.PlaybackSpeed=1.05
successSparkle.Parent=SoundService

local fail=Instance.new("Sound")
fail.Name="NotEnoughEnergySound"
fail.SoundId="rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav"
fail.Volume=.6
fail.PlaybackSpeed=.38
fail.Parent=SoundService

event.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind)
 if kind=="Upgrade" then
  success:Play()
  task.delay(.12,function() successSparkle:Play() end)
 elseif kind=="NotEnough" then
  fail:Play()
 end
end)
